llmResponse.agenda_changes: At the start of the meeting during Changes to the Agenda, the board moved items 12.1, 12.3, and 12.4 to consent. Item 12.1 appears to be Approval of November 17th Board Minutes (Study Session on CNS), item 12.3 is Discard Obsolete and Damaged Library Books, and item 12.4 is Approval of Amended Agreement between RCSD and One Life Counseling and Star Vista. These three items were approved as part of the consent bundle rather than discussed individually.
